sloka: ततः सिंहासनं त्यक्त्वा मेरुकूटमिवांशुमान् ।पश्यतो मे तदा राम विमानादवरुह्य च ।तं शवं भक्षयामास स स्वर्गी रघुनन्दन ।। ७.७७.१५ ॥
transliteration: tataḥ siṁhāsanaṁ tyaktvā merukūṭamivāṁśumān ।paśyato me tadā rāma vimānādavaruhya ca ।taṁ śavaṁ bhakṣayāmāsa sa svargī raghunandana ।। 7.77.15 ॥

translations.english: Then, O Rama, O delight of the Raghus, while I watched, that celestial being, like the sun leaving the peak of Meru, descended from his celestial chariot, abandoned his throne, and proceeded to eat that corpse.
translations.hindi: मेरे जाने से यदि यह यहाँ रहेंगे, तो फिर इनको क्लेश न होगा | जब शत्रुन्न ने ऐसा कहा, तब श्रीरामचन्द्र जी पुनः बोले
